# Spleen 8x16 - the font of the x86-64 console

Spleen is a monospaced bitmap font by Frederic Cambus, released under the
BSD 2-Clause license. This tree carries the 8x16 face, version 2.3.0
(2026-11-16), and uses the printable ASCII of it in the console of the
x86-64 port.

* Upstream: <https://github.com/fcambus/spleen>
* Upstream file: `spleen-8x16.bdf`, version 2.3.0
* License: [`LICENSE`](LICENSE), BSD 2-Clause
* Used in: `ports/port_x86_64/src/font_spleen.c` (generated), the 8x16
  console of `ports/port_x86_64/src/fb.c`
* Generated by: `tools/spleen_font.py` from `spleen-8x16.bdf` in this
  directory; a new version is a new file here and a new run of the tool

The font data is a part of the x86-64 kernel image. A binary distribution of
that image (the `MicroOS-x86_64-*.tar.gz` of `tools/bundle.sh`) carries a
copy of the license in `LICENSE.spleen`, as the BSD 2-Clause license asks.

The 5x7 font of the ESP32 board is a different font, in `components/font`,
and is not derived from Spleen.
